prompt: ECMAScript IsTypedArrayOutOfBounds zero-length ByteOffset equals bufferByteLength
answer: A zero-length TypedArray whose `[[ByteOffset]]` equals `bufferByteLength` is **not considered out-of-bounds**. `IsTypedArrayOutOfBounds` returns `false`, because it only returns `true` when `byteOffsetStart > bufferByteLength` or `byteOffsetEnd > bufferByteLength`. (ECMAScript 2027 Language Specification, §10.4.5.14)
